title: Recover a proven push after a false orphan-intent refusal
description: Real temporary Postgres and a first-parent Git remote exercise an orphan refusal while a measured trial runs, its actual push, interruption before the final record, and canonical restart delivering exactly once. Failed/latest failed trials, trial refusals, missing proofs, unheld commits and changed candidate, policy or review bindings stay undelivered.

steps.name: real merge-record recovery and security regressions
